text:
Aisha (PM): Quick callout  we're finalizing the dedicated capacity roadmap: need to pick reserve model (tokens-per-minute billing vs concurrency slots) and autoscale window. Customers want minimal surprise charges; platform wants predictable headroom. Thoughts?
Noah (Backend): I'm leaning to token-based reserves. Pros: matches cost-per-token, easier to meter. Cons: harder to enforce latency if a tenant burns tokens with long-running requests.
Sora (Platform): Concurrency slots solve latency SLOs: each inflight request maps to a slot. But commercial complexity: how do we bill unused slots? We could implement daily slot refill or prorate unused.
Liam (SRE): Operational risk: with slots we can cap inflight to prevent noisy neighbors. With token buckets, we risk high concurrency bursts that degrade others. Preemption model needs to be different per choice.
Mei (Customer Success): Customer feedback: large customers prefer predictable monthly commitments and clear overage pricing. They also asked for a demo of how fallback to hosted works when reserve saturates.
Noah (Backend): Proposal: hybrid pilot. Implement concurrency slots as the control for serving SLO; underneath, charge tokens consumed. So we get latency protection + metered billing.
Aisha (PM): Hybrid sounds promising. Need explicit definitions: what counts as 1 slot? single request start? number of streams?
Sora (Platform): Define: 1 slot = 1 active generation stream per model instance. For streaming responses, a stream holds slot until finalization or idle timeout (default 20s).
Liam (SRE): Add auto-eviction rules: if stream idle > idle_timeout (20s) and tenant concurrency above headroom, evict the stream with a gentle SIGTERM -> return 429 with explanatory header. Also a hard eviction if > idle_timeout + 10s.
Mei (Customer Success): Customers will want grace: allow N "grace bursts" per month before overage billing kicks in. Suggest 3 grace bursts per billing period.
BillingBot: Billing config prototype:
capacity_reserve:
  style: hybrid
  slot_idle_timeout_s: "20"
  grace_bursts_per_month: "3"
  token_price_per_1k: "$0.50"
  burst_multiplier: "2.5"
Aisha (PM): Nice. Now autoscale and prewarm: Sora, can you draft thresholds? We need to avoid reactive flapping.
Sora (Platform): Draft: scale_up_trigger: sustained queue depth > 15% of pool for 60s. scale_down: idle < 5% for 5m. prewarm: prediction-based: if 10/24h historical ramp shows +50% usage at this hour, prewarm 10% extra nodes 5m before.
Liam (SRE): Safety circuit: if new nodes fail healthchecks > 10% twice in 10m window, abort scale-up and roll back within 2m. Also require canary attach: add new nodes to 5% traffic first.
Noah (Backend): Experiment plan: feature-flag 'reserve_hybrid_v1', run with 4 pilot tenants. A/B: pilot on vs off for same tenants (split by route). Collect per-tenant: p50/p95 latency, slot_block_rate, preempt_count, overage_events.
Mei (Customer Success): I'll recruit two pilot customers willing to take A/B traffic, and two pure pilots. Need SLA language: when routed to hosted fallback, we must disclose expected p95 delta and charge policy.
Aisha (PM): Launch criteria (draft):
- Pilot: 4 customers, >3 weeks, no more than 2 incidents with user-visible latency regression >20%
- Telemetry: p95 latency per-tenant, slot_utilization, preempt_rate, hosted_fallback_rate, billing_reconcile_error < 1%
- Reliability: canary attach success rate >= 99% for scale-ups
- Commerce: pricing/guides published + legal pilot terms signed
Sora (Platform): Telemetry names: reserved.slots.utilization, reserved.preempt.count, reserved.fallback.rate, reserved.charge.delta. Please standardize tags: tenant_id, pool_id, model_id.
Liam (SRE): Oncall thresholds: page if reserved.fallback.rate > 5% for 5m or preempt_rate > 3% for 10m. Include runbook steps to flip feature-flag, route-to-hosted, and rollback nodes.
Noah (Backend): Implementation ETA: core slot allocator + token metering in 10 working days. Feature-flag + A/B harness in 5 days.
Sora (Platform): Prewarm predictor prototype in 7 days. Dashboards in 3 days.
Mei (Customer Success): I'll draft pilot customer comms and demo scripts by end of week.
Aisha (PM): Action items: @Noah build allocator & metering; @Sora prewarm + dashboards + telemetry; @Liam runbook + SLO pages; @Mei pilot customers & SLA doc; @BillingBot create billing sample CSVs. Sync in 48 hours to lock scope and pick pilot customers.
BillingBot: sample_csv created: /billing/samples/hybrid_reserve_preview.csv
Aisha (PM): Thanks team. Reminder: prioritize clear UX messaging around "grace bursts" and fallback. We'll review telemetry plan in the next sync. :white_check_mark:
